Shipping

Last updated: September 24, 2026

1. Timing

Every portrait is created and printed to order. The process is:

  • Digital proof: we email it to you within 48 business hours of your purchase.
  • Production: 2 to 4 business days after you approve the proof.
  • Shipping: about 3 to 7 business days within the United States, and 4 to 8 business days to mainland Spain and the rest of the European Union.

These are estimates and may be longer during peak seasons (Black Friday, holidays). If you need your portrait by a specific date, email us before ordering and we'll confirm whether we can make it.

2. Where we ship

We ship to the United States and to the European Union countries available at checkout. Your portrait is printed at the partner print facility closest to you (for US orders, in the United States), which means faster delivery and no customs fees for you.

3. Shipping cost

Shipping costs are calculated and shown at checkout before you confirm your purchase. In the US, any applicable sales tax is shown at checkout.

4. Tracking

Once your order leaves production, you'll receive an email with your tracking number.

5. Delivery address

Please double-check your address before paying. If you spot a mistake, email us as soon as possible at contacto@kivoa.es: we can correct it as long as the order hasn't shipped. If a package is returned because of an incorrect address provided by the customer, reshipping will be charged.

6. Damage in transit

If your portrait arrives damaged, see our returns section: we'll reprint and reship it at no cost to you.

Returns & refunds

1. Custom-made products

Every Kivoa portrait is created from the photos, name and details you provide and made exclusively for you. For this reason, we don't accept returns for change of mind, for choosing the wrong size or frame, or for details entered incorrectly by the customer. (For customers in the EU: the 14-day right of withdrawal does not apply to personalized goods, under article 103.c of Spanish Royal Legislative Decree 1/2007.)

2. Your guarantee

This doesn't affect your statutory rights as a consumer (in the EU, the 3-year legal guarantee of conformity). If your order arrives:

  • damaged in transit (broken acrylic, dented frame),
  • with a printing or manufacturing defect,
  • or not matching the proof you approved (different name, date or design),

we'll reprint and reship it free of charge or, if you prefer or a reprint isn't possible, refund you in full, shipping included. You don't need to send the defective item back unless we specifically ask you to; in that case, we cover the return shipping.

3. How to request it

Email us at contacto@kivoa.es with your order number and one or more photos of the issue (and of the packaging, if it's transit damage). So we can file a claim with the carrier, please let us know about shipping damage as soon as possible, ideally within 7 days of delivery. This request doesn't shorten your statutory guarantee.

We reply within 48 business hours.

4. Digital proof and cancellations

Before printing, we send you a digital proof with up to 2 rounds of changes included. You can cancel your order for a full refund at any time before approving it. Once approved, your portrait goes into production and can no longer be canceled, as it's a custom-made item. If we don't hear back within 7 calendar days, we'll send you a reminder and, if there's still no reply, we'll produce the latest version sent.

5. Color differences

Every screen displays colors slightly differently. Small variations in tone between the on-screen proof and the physical print are not considered a defect. Obvious differences are, and we'll resolve them as described in point 2.

6. Refund timing and method

Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 14 days of confirming the issue. Depending on your bank, it may take a few extra days to show up.

Terms & conditions of sale

Last updated: September 24, 2026

1. Who we are

This website (kivoa.es) and the Kivoa store are operated by Kivoa, based at Avenida Alcalde Don Juan Rodríguez, 11370 Los Barrios (Cádiz), Spain. Contact: contacto@kivoa.es.

2. Scope

These terms govern the sale of custom illustrated pet portraits and other personalized products through kivoa.es. By placing an order you confirm that you have read and accepted them. You must be 18 or older to purchase.

3. How ordering works

  1. Choose the style, size and frame.
  2. Upload your pet's photos and fill in the personalization details (name, traits, quote, date).
  3. Review your cart, enter your shipping details and pay.
  4. You'll receive an order confirmation email, which serves as proof of your contract.
  5. We send you a digital proof of your portrait for approval before printing.

4. Prices and payment

Prices for EU customers include VAT. For US customers, any applicable sales tax is calculated at checkout. Shipping costs are shown before you complete your purchase. We accept the payment methods shown at checkout, securely processed by Shopify Payments and its providers. We never store your card details.

5. Personalization and photos

  • You're responsible for making sure the personalization details (name, dates, text) are spelled correctly. We produce the portrait exactly as you provide them and as approved in the proof.
  • Portrait quality depends on photo quality. If a photo isn't suitable (very blurry, dark or low resolution), we'll contact you before production to ask for another one.
  • You confirm you have the right to use the photos you send us, and you grant us a limited license to use them solely to create and produce your order.
  • We will never publish your portrait or photos on social media or our website without your express consent.
  • We reserve the right to decline orders with offensive or illegal content, or content that infringes third-party rights, with a full refund.

6. Digital proof and approval

  • Within 48 business hours of your purchase, we email you a digital proof of your portrait.
  • It includes up to 2 rounds of changes at no cost (colors, text, traits, cropping). A complete change of style or new photos are treated as a new order.
  • Nothing is printed without your approval. Production starts once you give us the go-ahead.
  • If we don't hear back within 7 calendar days, we'll send you a reminder; if there's still no reply, we'll produce the latest version sent.
  • You can cancel your order for a full refund at any time before approving the proof.

7. Creative process

Portraits are created from your photos using digital tools, including artificial intelligence, and each one is individually reviewed and fine-tuned before printing. Each portrait is an artistic interpretation, not an exact photographic reproduction.

8. Production and shipping

Products are made to order through our network of print and production partners in the United States and Europe. See our shipping policy for timing and delivery terms.

9. Returns and guarantee

As custom-made products, portraits can't be returned for change of mind (for EU customers, the right of withdrawal does not apply under article 103.c of Spanish consumer law). Your statutory rights are not affected. Full details in our returns & refunds policy.

10. Intellectual property

The styles, templates, designs, text and images on this website belong to Kivoa. The portrait you purchase is for your personal, private use; reproducing it or using it commercially requires our permission.

11. Data protection

We process your data in accordance with our privacy policy.

12. Governing law and complaints

These terms are governed by Spanish law, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer protection rules of your country of residence. If you have any issue, please email us first at contacto@kivoa.es and we'll resolve it as quickly as possible.
